description: This dataset will include specis lists, data tables and R scripts used for the statistical analysis of the article: Kirsch, F., Haß, A. L., Alfert, A. and Westphal, C. (2024): “Landscape diversity, habitat connectivity, age and size determine the conservation value of limestone quarries for diverse wild bee communities” (Journal of Applied Ecology).

distribution.name: data_table_landscape_diversity_habitat connectivity_age_and_size_determine_the_conservation_value_of_limestone_quarries.csv
distribution.description: Use this data table to run R scripts for all response variables.

distribution.name: R_script_abundance.R
distribution.description: R script to analyze the effects of local habitat features, landscape variables and their interactions on the average wild bee abundance per study site and run in limestone quarries. Execute the script with the data table "data_table_landscape_diversity_habitat connectivity_age_and_size_determine_the_conservation_value_of_limestone_quarries.csv". Further comments can be found in the script.

distribution.name: R_script_species_rarefaction_curve.R
distribution.description: R script for calculating the estimated species richness and creating a species rarefaction curve. Execute the script with the data object "species_rarefaction_curve.txt". Further comments can be found in the script.

distribution.name: R_script_species_richness.R
distribution.description: R script to analyze the effects of local habitat features, landscape variables and their interactions on the average wild bee richness per study site and run in limestone quarries. Execute the script with the data table "data_table_landscape_diversity_habitat connectivity_age_and_size_determine_the_conservation_value_of_limestone_quarries.csv". Further comments can be found in the script.

distribution.name: R_script_threatened_bee_species.R
distribution.description: R script to analyze the effects of local habitat features, landscape variables and their interactions on the average richness of threatened wild bees per study site and run in limestone quarries. Execute the script with the data table "data_table_landscape_diversity_habitat connectivity_age_and_size_determine_the_conservation_value_of_limestone_quarries.csv". Further comments can be found in the script.

distribution.name: Species_list_plants_wild_bees.tab
distribution.description: List of plant and wild bee species recorded during the survey.

distribution.name: species_rarefaction_curve.txt
distribution.description: Data object for calculating the estimated species richness and creating a species rarefaction curve with the R script "R_script_species_rarefaction_curve.R".
